name: balance-subhead
title: Balance Subhead
description: A subhead that uses text-wrap: balance with a JS fallback that greedily evens line lengths for older engines — ragged edges tamed typographically, with a live before/after toggle for teaching the difference.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Swiss
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Toggle Compare: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
